scope: Frozen task and frozen rules; source/security inspection only, no configured judge or provider run.

reviewed_findings.explanation: apt-get update consumes current mutable repository metadata; apt-get install names packages without =version or a Debian snapshot.
Version-family tags are supplied, but no immutable digest is bound; tag bytes can move.
Frozen task Dockerfiles are byte-identical to frozen template Dockerfiles; repair belongs to a justified shared-template update.

nonissues: task.toml:34 uses a variable reference, not a literal credential.
environment/Dockerfile:20 uses reserved example domain turing@local.invalid, not a real personal address.
environment/assets/seed_data.json contains no person records, snippets, or credentials.
solution/app/package-lock.json resolves 168 registry packages and every resolved package carries integrity.
The .invalid network-control URL in functional/prompt.md is intercepted locally and is not a live remote dependency.
External app assets are allowed by instruction.md:15 and are not themselves an unpinned task fetch.

thought_experiments.weak_app_that_could_pass_judge: A feature-complete-looking app could expose a live key in its bundle while passing browser behavior; this row must inspect shipped bytes independently.
thought_experiments.conforming_alternative_that_could_fail_c: A conforming app may load external fonts or CDN assets because instruction.md explicitly permits them; URL presence alone is not a row-52 defect.
